question: Does adapting visual blocks 10 and 11 improve over last-block B5 and frozen B4?

data.test_policy: Do not read final-test images or labels

views: experiment-006 predicted-mask bbox natural crop with 10% context
inputs.preprocessing: B4 deterministic CLIP validation preprocessing; no augmentation
inputs.frozen_feature_arrays: used only to reproduce B4 train-only standardization statistics
